chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, and Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Abd al-Karim, from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

When the death of a man is announced to his family, or she is informed that he has divorced her, so she observes the waiting period, then remarries. So her first husband comes. He (peace be upon him) said: 'The first (husband) is more rightful with her than the later one, whether he has copulated with her or not copulated with her, and for her is the dower from the later one with what he had permitted from her relief'.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling when a woman's first husband returns after she has remarried following his death or divorce?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi outlines the ruling of 'Iddah al-Zann' (waiting period based on presumption) where a woman remarries after hearing of her first husband's death or divorce, only for him to return. It establishes that the first husband retains priority to reclaim her, while the second husband retains his mahr as compensation for the period he was entitled to intimacy, a principle rooted in the Shia interpretation of marital validity during the interim period.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ibn Abu Nasr, from Abdul Kareen, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When the obituary of the man comes to his wife, or she is informed that he has divorced her, so she observes the waiting period, then remarries. So her first husband comes over. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The first (husband) is more rightful with her than the later one, whether he has copulated with her or not copulated with her, and for her is the dower from the later one with what she had permitted him from her relief’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad and Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father all from ibn abu Nasr from ‘Abd al-Karim from Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

If a woman receives news of the death of her husband or she is informed about her being divorced by her husband and she counts her waiting period and thereafter marries, then her previous husband comes. The first one is more rightful than the second one, regardless, he (the second) has gone to bed with her or not; but she can demand mahr (dower) from the second one because of his going to bed with her and the second one can thereafter never lawfully marry her again.”’
